description: Gut training low (0.7× multiplier) — running 90 min. Reduced carb targets reflecting 70% of moderate baseline. Tests conservative fueling path.
knownFailureReason: CONFIRMED on real dev catalog: rule solver is non-deterministic at this target (38g carbs, 500mg sodium). Some runs pick energy_chews_mini_pack as primary carb (80mg+100mg sodium = ~400mg, borderline at delta=100mg floor), others pick carb_drink_mix (80mg from half-serving, leaving insufficient headroom for electrolytes, delivering 370mg sodium, delta=130mg > 100mg floor). The real catalog has 5 competing primary-carb candidates with nearly equal preference scores; tie-breaking is order-dependent. Solver non-determinism exposed by real catalog's richer food pool vs the synthetic 8-food set.
